title: Normalization of a projective-line overlap unit
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $P=\mathbf P^1_k$, $U_i=D_+(x_i)$, $U=U_0\cap U_1$, and $q=x_0/x_1$ [def-sc-p1-standard]. For every unit $v\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_P)^\times$ there are $d\in\mathbf Z$ and $a\in\Gamma(U_0,\mathcal O_P)^\times$ such that $a|_U v=q^d$, the standard degree-$d$ transition unit.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, divisors-lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, proof specialized to n=1 over a field; OverlapUnitNormalization

proof.text: Lift the overlap unit uniquely to a Laurent polynomial unit using [lem-sfb-projective-line-overlap-laurent-coordinates] and Units.map_bijective.

Apply the Laurent-unit surjectivity clause of [lem-pur-affine-punctured-line-algebra] to its canonical specUnitSection. Cancel the GammaSpec unit map and the type tags to obtain an actual equality w=c z^n of ring units.
Evaluate the equality on the overlap. Set d=n (z=x_0/x_1) and take a to be the constant chart unit c^-1. Restriction preserves constants, so a|_U v=c^-1 c q^n=q^n.

theorem exists_normalized_overlap_unit (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (v : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)),
      standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⊓
        standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))ˣ) :
    ∃ (d : ℤ)
      (a : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)),
        standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))ˣ),
      Units.map ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom.toMonoidHom a * v =
          transitionUnit (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) d ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩
